name: Boom Tube
pages: Open a Boom Tube to the safe ground position you aim at, up to 48 blocks away in loaded terrain. Arrival unleashes a six-block shockwave against up to eight visible enemies for 65 configured damage and knockback. Fourteen-second base cooldown. Same dimension only; the destination must fit your body, have solid support, and be free of hazards. Failed attempts still spend the ability cooldown. Requires the complete Darkseid set.
